critical_issues.msg: NotFoundException uses Chinese string '客户' instead of English; mixes languages in error messages
critical_issues.suggestion: Use 'Customer' (consistent with class/file naming) instead of '客户'

critical_issues.msg: NotFoundException uses Chinese string '客户' instead of English; mixes languages in error messages
bulk_import has no transaction rollback on failure; if commit partially fails the session is left inconsistent with no error raised (rule 47)
critical_issues.suggestion: Wrap the loop + commit in try/except and rollback on failure, or use add_all with proper error handling

suggestions.msg: create_customer dict path does not validate 'status' against VALID_STATUSES before inserting — invalid status can bypass validation (rule 48)
suggestions.suggestion: Add status validation after line 48: if d.get('status') and d['status'] not in self.VALID_STATUSES: raise ValidationException(...)

suggestions.msg: search_customers has no input sanitization — empty/whitespace-only keyword produces a LIKE '% %' that matches unintended rows; also limit(100) is fixed with no offset pagination (rule 52, 95)
suggestions.suggestion: Strip keyword and raise ValidationException if empty; consider adding offset pagination

suggestions.msg: bulk_import dict path does not validate 'status' against VALID_STATUSES — invalid status silently persists (rule 48)
suggestions.suggestion: Validate status inside the loop: if c.get('status') and c['status'] not in self.VALID_STATUSES: raise ValidationException(...)
